description: Upgrade plan to migrate Java project to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21 (latest LTS). Update build configuration files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21. Ensure all Java language features and APIs are compatible with Java 21.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from version 17 to 21 (LTS). Updated java.version property in parent pom.xml. Build and unit tests pass.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 (latest stable). Update Spring Framework to 6.x. Migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace. Update deprecated Spring Boot configurations and properties. Ensure compatibility with Spring Boot 3.4 features and breaking changes.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Spring Boot from 3.2.1 to 3.4.7 (latest stable). Spring Framework 6.2.x pulled in transitively. Jakarta namespace already in use. Build and unit tests pass.

tasks.description: Upgrade project dependencies to latest compatible versions
tasks.requirements: Update all project dependencies to versions compatible with Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4. Update Maven/Gradle plugins to latest stable versions. Resolve any dependency conflicts. Ensure all libraries support the jakarta.* namespace.
